% Shared normative core: assumptions and validity
\section{Assumptions and validity domain}
\label{sec:assumptions}

The unbiasedness, response, optimality, and covariance statements are valid
only on the intersection of the following declared predicates. Every product
shall identify which predicates were evaluated, by whose authority, and with
what immutable evidence.

\begin{longtable}{p{0.16\linewidth}p{0.74\linewidth}}
\toprule
ID & Assumption or predicate \\
\midrule
\endhead
\texttt{ASM-001} & The parent is exactly one immutable normalized ordinary-MAP
observation or coadd bundle with authoritative identity, generation, grouping,
WCS/frame, support, units, calibration provenance, and coadd membership when
applicable. \\
\texttt{ASM-002} & Parent, template, physical amplitude, filtered amplitude,
and sample-basis covariance have the declared real codomains; the chart,
indexing order, sampling, pixel measure, and coordinate transformations are
common to parent, template, operator, and response, or an exact declared
mapping relates them. Any complex transform representation preserves real-
field conjugacy and uses the corresponding Hermitian adjoint. \\
\texttt{ASM-003} & $t_x$ is the one immutable template-response product for
the application and expresses expected parent-map response per unit declared
amplitude, with fixed scale, anchor, and phase. \\
\texttt{ASM-004} & The complete influence support is present and valid. No
admitted output depends on fill, extension, imputation, partial support,
edge renormalization, adaptive background, learned taper, or signal-derived
support. \\
\texttt{ASM-005} & $Q_x$ is the exact frozen realized weighting object named
by the selected \AO{001} alternative, including domain, population, units,
rank, null space, regularization, window, and edge rules. \\
\texttt{ASM-006} & $D(x)$ is finite, real within the declared numerical
identity tolerance, and strictly positive. \\
\texttt{ASM-007} & For amplitude unbiasedness, the admitted noise has zero
conditional mean on the complete support given the frozen state and does not
induce target-dependent changes in the template or operator. \\
\texttt{ASM-008} & For the GLS optimality claim, $C_{\rm parent}$ is the exact
authorized covariance for the population, support, conditioning, and
constraints, and $Q_x$ is its exact inverse on the same estimable subspace. \\
\texttt{ASM-009} & For $C_{\rm cond}$, $L$, $C_{\rm parent}$, response,
support, units, and conditioning state refer to the same realization and
generation. \\
\texttt{ASM-010} & The state is externally declared or learned once from the
exact parent and external inputs, then frozen. It is neither target-updated nor
NOI-member relearned. \\
\texttt{ASM-011} & A compatible NOI ensemble member receives the identical
state, operator, support, normalization, approximation, and failure policy as
the signal parent. \\
\texttt{ASM-012} & Any approximate operator satisfies a selected and fully
parameterized \AO{002} envelope on its complete declared test domain. \\
\texttt{ASM-013} & Response and uncertainty representations satisfy selected
\AO{003} and \AO{005} reconstruction, omitted-mode, consumer, and lifecycle
limits. \\
\texttt{ASM-014} & Template and parent calibration lineages are compatible;
any claimed point-source flux meaning or calibration covariance has explicit
CAL/BEAM authority. \\
\texttt{ASM-015} & A method option, named-use policy, and lifecycle route are
explicitly selected; there is no automatic selector, fallback, or silent
substitution. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\subsection{Validity table}
\label{sec:validity-table}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.16\linewidth}p{0.29\linewidth}p{0.25\linewidth}p{0.20\linewidth}}
\toprule
Dimension & Admission evidence & Invalid or missing case & Required outcome \\
\midrule
\endhead
Parent identity & Exact bundle identity, class, generation, grouping, WCS/frame,
support, unit, quantity, calibration lineage, and coadd membership & Missing,
mutable, derived, or mixed parent & \Unavailable{} before application; no
FLT repair or coaddition. \\
Application class & Observation or coadd declared independently & Assumed
commutation or borrowed state between classes & \Unavailable{}; require a
distinct realization. \\
Template & Exact materialized response per unit amplitude with scale, phase,
anchor, sampling, and lineage & Learned from target/member, mismatched chart,
ambiguous scale, or missing lineage & \Unavailable{}; no inferred template. \\
Influence support & Complete dependency closure and erosion proof & Missing,
invalid, filled, extended, imputed, or partially supported dependency & Mark
affected locations \Unavailable{}; no partial estimate. \\
Weighting state & Selected \AO{001}, population, operator, rank/null,
regularization, coefficients, window and edge rules bound to $g$ & Unknown,
unselected, incompatible, or changing $Q_x$ & Fail closed; no fallback. \\
Normalization & Finite, real-to-tolerance, strictly positive $D(x)$ & NaN,
infinite, complex beyond tolerance, zero, negative, or null-confounded &
Location \Unavailable{} or attempted bundle \Failed{}; never write zero. \\
Approximation & Selected \AO{002} and all metrics within bounds on the full
test domain & Missing exact comparator, uncovered modes, support/null mismatch,
or any exceeded bound & \Failed{} for that realization; material change is a
new realization or method. \\
Response & Full fixed-state response or selected exact reconstruction contract
& Undocumented kernel, assumed invariance, or unreconstructable response &
Response-dependent product or handoff \Unavailable{}. \\
Units and calibration & $[\widehat A]=[m]/[t]$ and compatible joint lineage &
Unjustified flux, beam, solid angle, DC, extended-source, or covariance meaning
& Forbid the claim; required named use is \Unavailable{}. \\
Covariance & Matching authorized $C_{\rm parent}$ and selected \AO{003} &
Missing population/conditioning, omitted correlations treated as zero, or
$D^{-1}$ used without GLS & Covariance use \Unavailable{} or companion
\Failed{}; signal may remain \Complete{}. \\
NOI parity & Identical frozen transformation for compatible members &
Per-member relearning, different support, or mixed generation & NOI companion
\Unavailable{} or \Failed{}; separate method required. \\
Lifecycle & Atomic membership, named-use policy, and immutable state & Mixed
status, partial signal bundle, silent mutation, or overwritten predecessor &
Bundle \Failed{}; retain predecessor and successor identities. \\
FLT to FRUIT & Selected \AO{005}, documented response/state lineage, and
handoff profile & Requires undocumented implementation state or supplies FRUIT
science & Handoff \Unavailable{}; signal product status is unchanged. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

The valid output domain $\Valid$ is the intersection of all location-level
predicates above. Bundle-level validity additionally requires all atomic
identity and lifecycle members. Consumer-specific validity is never broader
than producer validity and may be narrower under a named-use policy.
